body_long:
EquipHotel, France's main trade show for hotel and restaurant suppliers, opens on Monday 2 November 2026 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. The show's materials give both 5 and 6 November as closing date; Yonder lists the last day as Thursday 5 November, closing at 17:30.

## Scale and theme

The 2026 edition brings together more than 1,200 exhibitors, nearly a third from abroad, and expects around 80,000 professionals from 133 countries. Its theme, plural hospitality, reflects the range of accommodation now on offer, from campsites to palaces. It is organised around three ideas: standing out from competitors, creating memorable moments during a stay, and hosting with more sobriety, with artificial intelligence helping teams work more efficiently.

The show is split by sector: design, furniture, tableware and lighting in pavilions 7.1 and 7.2; technology, services and foodservice in pavilion 7.3; and wellbeing, spa, fitness and bedding in pavilion 4.

## Highlights

The exhibition Do Not Disturb, éloge de l'intime presents visions of the hotel room by architect Jean-Michel Wilmotte, designer and photographer Mathilde de l'Ecotais, designer Paul Emilieu and interior architects Maison A&G. The Exclusive Collection, nearly 1,000 square metres in pavilion 7.2, showcases French heritage craftsmanship.

Four stages host talks with simultaneous translation. Designer Hubert de Malherbe presents six trends for future hospitality on Tuesday 3 November, followed by the Innovation Awards, judged by a jury chaired by Laurent Gardinier, president of Relais & Châteaux. Thursday is dedicated to digital transformation with HITEC Paris.

## The signal

For general managers and owners preparing renovations, EquipHotel is the place to see what the next generation of rooms, restaurants and spas will look like, and which suppliers can deliver them.
